CRACKS :State if crack is AXIAL or RADIAL ; Use letters to indicate 
 crack location and give length of crack.
EROSION / CORROSION : Enter dimension from tip to edge of corrosion; 
 Use letters to indicate principle zone affected by corrosion; Enter 
 height, width, & estimated depth of corrosion / erosion spot.
FOREING OBJECT DAMAGE: Use letters to indicate location of damage, 
 Describe damage with key words such as TORN, MISSING METAL, PUNCTURED, 
 BENT, ETC
TIE-WIRE HOLE :Check (√) if tie-wire 
 hole is elongated out of limits (0.005"); leave blank if hole is okay
DISPOSITION: Use "RN" for replaced
